scope: symbolic and synthetic componentwise layer-3 entry-state box propagation only

routing_semantics.router_matrix_orientation: row i is expert i; z_i=sum_j W[i,j]*y_j
routing_semantics.linear_logit_bias: absent; theorem API accepts explicit zero or a reviewed successor bias
routing_semantics.selection: score descending; exact ties use lower expert ID
routing_semantics.normalization_order: top-k selection precedes normalization; selection bias is excluded from weight normalization
routing_semantics.ordered_top8_requirement: diagnostic only; selected-set membership is load-bearing

preconditions: x0, dx, and gamma are finite and shape-aligned
all row-specific guards are explicit, finite, non-negative, and row-aligned
state_box.proof_arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 interval endpoints with directed outward nextafter guards
state_box.model_input_materialization: binary32 values promoted exactly to binary64 before proof arithmetic
state_box.subnormal_policy: preserve finite subnormals; outward nextafter may produce minimum subnormal endpoints
state_box.signed_zero_policy: accepted as numerical zero; interval ordering does not distinguish signs
state_box.nan_infinity_policy: reject inputs and fail closed on intermediate overflow

rmsnorm_theorem.mean_square: outward sum of square intervals divided outward by dimension; lower endpoint clamped to algebraic zero
rmsnorm_theorem.gamma_scale: interval multiplication by exact promoted gamma_j
rmsnorm_theorem.dependency_policy: conservative interval dependency is accepted; no independence assumption narrows the quotient

router_logit_theorem.row_interval: outward signed interval products accumulated outward per row
router_logit_theorem.guard_application: add a symmetric outward row guard after the interval dot product and bias

score_theorem.sigmoid: monotone stable-branch sigmoid applied to interval endpoints with outward nextafter
score_theorem.correction_bias: selection-only binary32 correction bias promoted to binary64 and added after sigmoid with an explicit guard
score_theorem.membership_condition: D_ij.lower > 0 for every selected i and unselected j

safety_factor.factor: m_ij/a_ij rounded down; INFINITE when m_ij>0 and a_ij=0; zero when m_ij<=0

selected_weight_theorem.dependency: numerator occurrence in denominator is preserved by the monotone quotient formula

outward_rounding.mechanism: math.nextafter toward negative infinity for lower endpoints and positive infinity for upper endpoints
